name: spine-segment
description: Spine segmentation (STO-SCN-097): partition a long ordered frame pool into M OVERLAPPING segments, each within solver capacity (cap), adjacent segments sharing >= the overlap budget BY CONSTRUCTION. Pose-free outer loop of EPI-SCN-SPINE-ASSEMBLY — runs on capture order before any per-segment solve, like the pre-cull (STO-SCN-092). Reuses the 64-bit DCT pHash twice: (1) snap each cut earlier to a coherent transition so the shared region isn't a fast-motion gap, and measure per-seam registrability (mean consecutive pHash distance); (2) a cheap cross-segment scan flags loop/revisit candidates (non-adjacent segments) as extra pose-graph edges for STO-SCN-098. Emits the per-segment boundary_spec (pinned anchor frames + overlap region per neighbor) + the global camera_model (STO-SCN-091, identical per segment) that STO-SCN-094 honors. M=1 for a single tractable space (no seams). Pure-CPU; runs locally on the pool. Lives at the scene root.

cap.note: max frames per segment (solver capacity; the measured 16GB solve ceiling)

overlap.note: min shared frames per seam (registrability budget consumed by STO-SCN-098)

snap.note: boundary-snap search window (snaps a cut EARLIER to a coherent transition)

reg_thresh.note: max mean consecutive pHash distance for a seam to count as registrable

loop_thresh.note: max pHash distance for a cross-segment loop/revisit candidate

loop_min_sep.note: min segment separation for a loop candidate (skip adjacency)

loop_step.note: frame subsample stride for the loop scan (cost control on long pools)
